text:
adrian.sales: Quick sync — MedTech customer wants a 2-week POC that uses our Hosted API but needs a Private/VPC fallback for sensitive flows. Primary asks: scoped/ephemeral API keys, SAML SSO for console, evidence for audit logs (schema + retention), ability to stream logs to their Splunk HEC (or S3 with role), and proof of KMS integration. Also they asked about Dedicated pricing for evaluation. Can we stand this up next week?

maria.se: We can. For POC pattern we usually: hosted API (scoped key + IP allowlist) -> optional Private (VPC) with customer network peering. For logs we support HEC or S3 export. For short POCs we do ephemeral keys w/ TTL.

ben.sre: Audit log snapshot: we emit one NDJSON line per request with fields: request_id, timestamp, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, route, status, error_code (if any), tenant_id (if customer provides), region, and host_id. We also include request latency and kv_cache_hit. Default retention on hosted is 30 days, exports to S3 > longer via lifecycle.

priya.security: For KMS: hosted -> we encrypt at rest with our managed KMS. For Private/VPC we can plug customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS or external HSM) but onboarding the CMK and key policy changes takes a couple days and a security review. Also: we'll need to redact PHI by policy if they require it; ask them to confirm.

sam.platform: Dedicated pricing note — POC Dedicated pools are possible but require a short-term reserved commit (we usually do 1-week trial with a reduced min). Finance needs the ARR estimate to price. cc @adrian.sales to capture numbers.

maria.se: Steps I'll need from the customer to wire logs: either
1) Splunk HEC endpoint + HEC token + allowed IP ranges OR
2) S3 bucket name + write IAM role ARN + preferred prefix + retention policy

And for SAML SSO: IdP metadata XML or metadata URL and SP ACS we provide. For SCIM: not GA — we can do manual provisioning for POC.

adrian.sales: They also want sample audit artifacts for SOC2 reviewers before kickoff. We can share a redacted sample export and our SOC2 cert after NDA.

priya.security: Please get them to sign the NDA. Once signed I'll provide redacted logs + controls mapping. Also need to see their security questionnaire — send now and I'll triage. :eyes:

ops-bot: Audit export job created for thread 1912345678 — temporary bucket path s3://redwood-poc-exports/medtech/1912345678/ (auto-delete after 14 days).

ben.sre: Sample NDJSON line (redacted):
```
{"request_id":"req_01GXxQ","timestamp":"2026-03-18T15:02:11Z","tenant_id":"redacted","model":"gptx-3.8","prompt_tokens":54,"completion_tokens":128,"total_tokens":182,"route":"hosted-us-west-2","status":"ok","latency_ms":132}  
```

maria.se: Ephemeral key flow (POC): create a scoped key with TTL 24h, attach scope=generate, routes=[hosted-us-west-2], allowed_ips=[customer egress]. Example API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>" \
  -d '{"name":"medtech-poc-ephemeral","ttl_seconds":86400,"scopes":["generate"],"allowed_ips":["198.51.100.0/24"]}'
```
Response will include ephemeral_key and expires_at.

adrian.sales: They asked whether we can forward logs to their Splunk instance over TLS — yes? Also, for the SSO they want console access for 4 users during POC.

priya.security: Splunk HEC over TLS is supported. We'll validate cert chain if they provide a custom endpoint. For console SAML: we can add 4 accounts as SAML users once IdP metadata is provided. SCIM still manual.

devex: I'll draft a short runbook (commands + sample dashboards + queries) and a Splunk sample search for token counts and errors. Posting a link shortly: https://internal.redwood.runbooks/medtech-poc (will be public to team).

sam.platform: Blockers to flag: 1) NDA signed (SOC2 artifacts) 2) Customer IdP metadata for SAML 3) If they require customer-managed KMS, security onboarding ~3 business days 4) Dedicated pool pricing signoff if they want to test Dedicated.

adrian.sales: Timeline: customer hopes to start next Tue. I'll escalate NDA and IdP today. If we can get log hookup and ephemeral keys before next Tue, good.

maria.se: I'll create infra ticket to provision ephemeral key + IP allowlist + S3 export path. Assigning to @ben.sre for S3/HEC hookup and to @devex for runbook.

ben.sre: Taking S3/HEC. I'll need their HEC token or a bucket role. If they pick S3 give me the bucket name + role. I can have the first export stream running in ~6-8 hours after creds.

priya.security: Send the security questionnaire now — I'll mark high-risk items and reply with required mitigations. For anything blocking we'll escalate to legal. :white_check_mark:

adrian.sales: Uploaded SFQ here: https://files.redwood/medtech/sfq-1912345678.pdf — please review.

maria.se: Great. I'll follow up with a checklist summary in this thread after we validate the SFQ items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
